title: AI Lets You Start This Amazon Side Hustle in Minutes

In this solo episode I walk through how I use @BookBolt  and AI to find real demand and publish simple books on Amazon KDP without touching inventory. I start with topics I actually know, then use Keyword Research and Product Search to spot long-tail gaps where competition is low but buyers are actively searching. I break down BSR, sales estimates, and how to turn ideas like journals, coloring books, and planners into polished interiors with BookBolt Studio. I also share why your first book is mostly for learning, how to avoid saturated niches, and a simple cadence for testing multiple titles until a few winners stick. If you follow along, you’ll see the exact workflow from idea to upload, plus practical tips on titles, templates, and keeping things unique so your book stands out.

Enjoy!
